BETA Close X The Sage Group PLC has announced the purchase of 1,074,132 of its ordinary shares on the London Stock Exchange and multilateral trading facilities. The purchases were made from J.P. Morgan Securities plc at prices ranging from 875.2000 pence to 891.0000 pence per share, with a volume-weighted average price of 881.1315 pence. These shares were acquired as part of a share buyback program initiated on March 2, 2026, which is scheduled to conclude by June 5, 2026, and all purchased shares will be cancelled. Disclaimer* Sage Group PLC (The) 08 May 2026 THE SAGE GROUP PLC TRANSACTION IN OWN SHARES The Sage Group plc ("Sage" or the "Group") announces today that it has purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 1 4 / 77 pence each on the London Stock Exchange and Multilateral Trading Facilities from J.P. Morgan Securities plc (''JPMS''). This is pursuant to the share buyback programme announced on 2 March 2026 which is expected to end no later than 5 June 2026. Ordinary Shares Date of purchase: 8 May 2026 Number of ordinary shares purchased: 1,074,132 Highest price paid per share: 891.0000 Lowest price paid per share: 875.2000 Volume weighted average price paid per share: 881.1315 Sage will cancel all the purchased shares.
